Implement lazy MMU update hooks which are SMP safe for both direct and shadow
page tables.  The idea is that PTE updates and page invalidations while in
lazy mode can be batched into a single hypercall.  We use this in VMI for
shadow page table synchronization
column2: and it is a win.  It also can be used by

column1: PPC and for direct page tables on Xen.
For SMP
column2: the enter / leave must happen under protection of the page table

column1: locks for page tables which are being modified.  This is because otherwise
you end up with stale state in the batched hypercall
race ahead of.  Doing this under the protection of the locks guarantees the
synchronization is correct
column2: and also means that spurious faults which are

column1: generated during this window by remote CPUs are properly handled
fault handler must re-check the PTE under protection of the same lock.
